name: Speed Department
description: Batch file writes and patches, context packs, complex project blueprints and speed benchmarks: fewer agent round-trips, more code per call.
capabilities: write many files in one atomic call
apply many edits in one transaction
multi-pattern repository search in one pass
context pack with tree and file contents
complex project scaffolds (python package, layered app, HTTP service, Paper feature pack)
instructions: Use speed.write instead of one write per file; speed.patch instead of repeated edit calls; speed.context before reading files one by one; speed.blueprint to create a whole structure. Always run a build/test after a batch and prefer dry_run for risky patches.
limits: writes stay inside an explicit root
atomic rollback on a failed batch
